A '''smokescreen generator''' was a droid component that could be attached to [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] to generate smoke. It was sold during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Astromech Smokescreen Attachment is a [[:w:c:cwa:Companion#Droid parts|droid part]] for players in the online game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]. It can be bought for 150 [[:w:c:cwa:Station Cash|Station Cash]].
